ig_caption:
This commit broke our AI chatbot. Seconds later it was in production. 🚨

AI wrote this GitHub Actions pipeline:
⚠️ every push goes straight to production
⚠️ no tests, no gate

So a typo, a bad prompt, a broken import... it all ships, and your users find the bug before you do.

The fix:
✅ a test job first
✅ deploy only if tests pass (needs: test)
✅ production waits for an approval (environment: production)

Same broken commit → the test fails → nothing deployed.

A pipeline isn't there to ship fast. It's there to stop bad code.

Save this for your next pipeline 🔖 Follow to see this chatbot reach production 🚀

#githubactions #cicd #devops #python #ai
yt_title: CI/CD gate: this commit broke our AI chatbot in prod #githubactions
yt_description:
Real runs with act (GitHub Actions locally):
- AI-style pipeline: one deploy job on every push, so the commit that broke answer() was "deployed to production"
- fixed pipeline: test job (python -m unittest) first, deploy needs: test, environment: production for approval. Same commit: AssertionError, test job failed, deploy never ran.

Next step for real deployments: log in to your cloud with OIDC instead of stored credentials.

Part of the "AI App to Production" journey: one AI chatbot from laptop to production. Follow along.
